title: Two men missing in sea off Devon beach on Christmas Day
summary: Emergency services launched major search at Budleigh Salterton after reports of people in difficulty in the water Two men are believed to be missing in the water off a beach in Devon, after a number of people were reported to be in difficulty. Emergency services were called to Budleigh Salterton at 10.25am on Christmas Day following concerns for people in the water. Continue reading...
